description: You are a satellite operations engineer performing a data collection pass on the INST satellite. The Command Sender tool is open in OpenC3 COSMOS. Your task: (1) In the Command Sender, select target 'INST' and command 'COLLECT', (2) Set the parameters: TYPE to 'NORMAL', DURATION to 5.0, and TEMP to 0.0, (3) Click 'Send' to execute the COLLECT command, (4) After sending, navigate to the Packet Viewer tool to verify the COLLECTS counter on the INST HEALTH_STATUS packet has incremented, confirming the data collection was performed. The password for OpenC3 is Cosmos2024! if you are prompted to log in.
